_comment: Expansion 6 G.7: the bands met near a host on the map (world/hosts.py, threats.json hosts groups): an army's foragers and a crusade's outriders. Never met at random (weight 0, no biome): only near their host. H.1 adds the bands that come out of a summoner's portal in an assault (assaults.json summoned) and the dragon that comes down on a town.

army_foragers.name: an army's foragers
intro: Soldiers driving a farmer's pigs ahead of them stop and look you over. "Who are you for?"
A party of foragers with the army's badge, and their sergeant does not like strangers on the road.
Soldiers off the line, looking for food and trouble, and you are one of the two.

crusaders.name: a crusade's outriders
intro: Riders under a holy banner block the road. "Stand and be known. The dead wear living faces now."
A priest in mail and his men-at-arms, outriders of the crusade, and they have hanged men on less than a hunch.
The crusade's scouts ride up with drawn swords and a question: are you living, and whose are you?

portal_imps.name: imps from the portal
intro: Small red things with barbed tails come at you out of the smoke, laughing.
Imps from the portal, wings buzzing, and they have seen you.
A knot of little devils drops off a roof onto the street in front of you.

town_dragon.name: the dragon
intro: The dragon drops out of the smoke into the street ahead of you, and the cobbles crack under it.
A roof caves in, and out of the dust and fire the dragon lifts its head and looks at you.
Heat like an opened oven, the reek of burning thatch, and the dragon turns in the street to face you.

portal_quasits.name: quasits from the portal
intro: Green horned things skitter out of an alley, claws wet.
Quasits from the portal, chittering, come at you low along the ground.
Something small and wrong flickers out of nothing at your elbow, and another behind it.
